lesson: It was sold on the quick-trade rule (the bounce back to the 5 day average, or the time limit) before target 1. That is by design: target 1 is a level only about half of past trades reached, and the edge of a dip trade ends once the bounce is done. Holding longer was tested and did worse.
Sold before the target and above the stop.
It reached target 1: the plan worked.
Sold before the target and above the stop.
It hit the stop: the loss was capped as planned. One stop is normal; a run of them is a lesson the review will catch.
lossType: gap through the stop (-1.8% past it)
